subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should Feishu multi-bot @mention admission proceed with a union_id-based fallback, switch to another proven cross-app identity strategy, or wait for the broader Feishu bot-to-bot identity work?
rationale: The submitted union_id source is contradicted by the linked issue and official bot info contract, while the changed admission path can suppress or admit Feishu group messages incorrectly if the identity strategy is wrong.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR against current main only after proving the stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this as investigation context and replace it only if a broader Feishu identity PR lands with positive proof for this exact app-scoped mention case.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally keep the union_id approach only with proof that the field populates and tests for text, post, command, forward, and debounce paths.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this PR against current main only after proving the stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned on the live PR and has recent Feishu mention-surface history, making them the best available owner for the identity strategy decision.
